description: This file defines the CommandPool class in the AWS SDK for PHP, which manages the concurrent execution of a pool of commands with configurable options such as concurrency level, callbacks before sending commands, and promise handling.

classes.name: CommandPool
classes.description: Manages the concurrent execution of commands with a configurable pool size, handling promise resolution and command iteration.

methods.name: promise
methods.description: Returns the promise representing the completion of all commands in the pool.

methods.name: batch
methods.description: Executes a set of commands concurrently and returns the aggregated results after completion.

methods.name: getBefore
methods.description: Retrieves or validates the 'before' callback from the configuration.
